content: Stacked modals need stack management: each dialog listening for Escape independently closes dialogs out of order; body scroll locks must be refcounted or the lock clears when the first (not last) modal closes; nested focus traps must hand focus to the new dialog or the underlying dialog's handlers still fire. Classic refs: jQuery-UI ESC-closes-all SO thread, HeadlessUI #2324, Drupal body_scroll_lock refcount bug, MDN <dialog> multi-modal guidance.
